verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.lithic.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the developer docs. Doc pages are served as raw .md URLs, and the docs MCP server lets AI assistants in Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot search the documentation. Together these are clear agent-oriented docs entry points. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs in practice.
